note: A domestic budget line: Vote 1024 programme 0626000 Population Management Services, KES 6,836,307,352 appropriated for FY2024/25 (June 2024), covering the National Registration Bureau, civil registration (6.3m birth certificates) and IPRS, with Civil Registration absorbing 99 percent.
